title: Malachi Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Malachi 1: Yahweh's love for Jacob, the polluted offerings of the priests, and his great name among the nations.

questions.text: Through whom does the opening verse say Yahweh's word came to Israel?
questions.explanation: Malachi 1:1 calls it a revelation, Yahweh's word to Israel by Malachi.

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he did to Esau's mountains?
questions.explanation: Malachi 1:3 says that Esau he hated, and made his mountains a desolation, and gave his heritage to the jackals of the wilderness.

questions.text: What will men call Edom, which says it will rebuild the waste places?
questions.explanation: Malachi 1:4 says Yahweh will throw down what they build, and men will call them The Wicked Land.

questions.text: Which two examples of honor does Yahweh use when he asks the priests where his honor is?
questions.explanation: Malachi 1:6 says a son honors his father, and a servant his master, and then asks where Yahweh's honor and respect are.

answers.text: A soldier and his captain, and a watchman on the wall
A farmer and his field, and a vinedresser and his vine
A shepherd and his flock, and a herdsman and his cattle
A son and his father, and a servant and his master

questions.text: What did the priests say about Yahweh's table?
questions.explanation: Malachi 1:7 says they offered polluted bread on his altar and said that Yahweh's table is contemptible.

questions.text: What does Yahweh tell the priests to do with the blind, lame and sick animals they offer?
questions.explanation: Malachi 1:8 asks whether that is not evil, and tells them to present it now to their governor and see whether he will be pleased with them.

questions.text: What does Yahweh wish that someone among them would do?
questions.explanation: Malachi 1:10 says: Oh that there were one among you who would shut the doors, that you might not kindle fire on my altar in vain.

answers.text: Shut the doors, so that fire is not kindled on his altar in vain
Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse of the temple
Read the law aloud to all the people at the feast
Tear down the altars that stand on the hills

questions.text: What does Yahweh say about his name among the nations?
questions.explanation: Malachi 1:11 says that from the rising of the sun to its going down his name is great among the nations.

answers.text: That it is unknown to them
That it is spoken only in Israel
That it will be revealed to them later
That it is great among them

questions.text: What did the priests say about bringing the offering?
questions.explanation: Malachi 1:13 says they said: Behold, what a weariness it is, and they sniffed at it.

answers.text: That it is required by the king

questions.text: Who does verse 14 say is cursed?
questions.explanation: Malachi 1:14 says the deceiver is cursed, who has a male in his flock yet vows and sacrifices a defective thing to the Lord.

answers.text: The priest who shuts the doors of the temple
The farmer who keeps back his grain from the market
The deceiver who sacrifices a defective thing to the Lord
The judge who takes a bribe from the rich
